title: RAD: Rapid Application Development
requirements: Connect the acronym to speed of GUI construction, not benchmark claims or “no programming required.”
Use the shared factoid style; “Did you know?” is optional source-plan framing, not mandatory filler.
Keep the face to the supplied/proposed short copy and maintain the longer source quote in the evidence file.
Any historical assertion must have a recorded verification result before release. Layout may proceed as an internal proof.
beats: Still: one factual idea and one focal visual/code token.
Optional emphasis state uses the same composition, with no additional claims.
checks: The card teaches only its named aside.
Historical provenance status is explicit in delivery metadata.
No invented statistic, date, market ranking, or current support claim was added.
Text is readable at the intended short editorial hold.
